purpose: Separate information-coverage and harmful-clearance experiment. This is a synthetic red-flag screening task, not disease diagnosis or proof of learned clinical safety.
subject_split_source: Frozen separate-state BASE split; new RISK session IDs, subject IDs never input. No history or condition score enters the acute warning classifier.
mixed: Two of high_temperature/low_spo2/high_hr. All other channels stay in the normal control range.
ground_truth: Episode category before measurement. The selected true intervals deliberately correspond to preset reference warning thresholds. High performance is expected under this construction and is not independent validation of the criteria.
threshold_provenance: HR40/120,T38,SpO2<94 inherited project research screen; not universal clinical boundaries. T<35 added as a reference below-normal-temperature scenario, informed by NHS hypothermia guidance. This is not NEWS2.
measurement_note: Gaussian measurement plus pre-fixed subject/device bias; observed bounded by clipping. CLEAN retains device bias but removes random noise/missing/artifact. All measurement cases share latent episode truth. Old sensor generators unchanged.

comparison.HR: Fixed HGB with HR value,quality,missing flag only
comparison.THREE: Same HGB with HR,T,SpO2 values/quality/missing flags
comparison.GUARD: Deterministic any-abnormal rule on good-quality observable channels. RECHECK for missing/low quality, unless another observed channel triggers FLAG.
comparison.HYBRID: FLAG if full AI or good-quality threshold warning; otherwise GUARD disposition. A favorable condition score can never override FLAG or RECHECK.

selection: Train only median/scaling and HGB. Validation threshold maximizes sensitivity subject to FPR<=0.05; ties lower FPR then higher threshold. No tuning, no final refit; frozen train model used on all held-out cases. Case shifts are test-only.
primary: BASE ID-test sensitivity and false-positive rate HR vs THREE. Paired seed differences with95% t CI. Report all categories including isolated abnormality with other channels normal.
secondary: Per-type/40C+ recall, AUROC, Brier, PPV, confusion counts, normal RECHECK burden, abnormal CLEAR rate. GUARD/HYBRID do not have calibrated probabilities; do not report their AI Brier/AUC.
uncertainty: 30 Monte Carlo seed intervals; not human population confidence intervals. Category/case analyses exploratory, no global multiplicity claims. PPV depends on enriched40% episode prevalence and must not be transferred to deployment.
functional_tests: Five single-warning sentinels crossed with11x11 condition/fatigue score pairs; no score cancellation. Missing any sentinel channel cannot lead CLEAR. Audit the frozen existing bundle separately; do not modify it.
safety_interpretation: RECHECK is uncertainty/defer, not successful warning detection. Report FLAG,RECHECK,CLEAR separately. Synthetic acute states and error distributions are assumptions. No claim every medical event is detectable from these channels.
freeze: No simulator/model parameter or threshold tuning after results. Existing experiments, models, application and paper unchanged.
